headline: South Korea's Central Bank Hikes Interest Rates to 3.25% Amid Inflation Pressures
summary: The Bank of Korea raised its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, reaching a two-year high, as robust AI-driven growth and inflation pressures persist.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions set the cost of borrowing within an economy, influencing currency valuation, bond yields, and commercial lending rates.

impacts.name: South Korea Base Rate
impacts.why: A policy rate hike directly increases the base interest rate set by the central bank.
